# P37.30 — Evidence recommender repair (manifest row 454, K7 WX-05)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/454_P37.30__evidence-recommender-repair.md`
**Base:** `r11/P37.29-in-place-map-on-dossiers` (chain)
**Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent · **live_verification=false** · gate: none · not an OM-20 row

## What this lands

The evidence-recommender repair (K7 §5.7, F-485 — "the recommender would rank all 255 published artifacts nationally with NaN scores for any decision"):

1. **Per-(artifact, subject) D/C/retrievability emitted.** `web/evidence.json` artifacts now carry `subject_scores[]` — the best §10.5 directness class and the best §28.3 currency class (derived at `as_of` via `reconcile.weight`, never stored) over the artifact's claims about THAT subject, plus the subject-scoped dispute flags — and the retrievability vocabulary mapped from `capture_status` + `disappeared_observed_at` (§17.6). The spine values moved to their true names (`primary_or_secondary`, `published_at_edtf`) instead of being stuffed into `directness`/`currency`. A pair whose axes can't be computed is counted under `build.recommender_scores` and emitted nowhere — an uncomputable score fails typed, never a silent zero.
2. **Subject scoping.** `recommendEvidence` ranks only artifacts bearing on the decision's subject — the `subject_scores` pair join, plus the one-hop contract/agency neighbourhood via the emitted `subject_neighbours` map (a bound claim's subject ↔ its object entity). Each `RankedArtifact` names the subject its score was computed over (`matched_subject`, `scored_subjects`).
3. **The NaN guard.** `assertFiniteScore` throws on any non-finite score (build-time, fails the page build), and `getEvidence` validates the emitted D/C vocabulary at ingest — both fail typed loudly, never the pre-repair 255-of-255 NaN list.
4. **Per-item ranked list.** `decision_point.json` gains `decision_points[]` (one per produced watch item, kind → §39.5a decision-type map); `/watch/item/<handle>/` renders "Evidence to bring (N)" and a per-item `citations.txt` (SIG-UI-027c). The national `decision_point` headline is unchanged.
